tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List every Carragent AI agent: what it does, when it runs, what waits for the owner's approval, what it never does and which tools (Stripe, Google Calendar, HubSpot…) it connects to. Use it when a user asks what Carragent can do or wants to compare the agents. Returns { agents: [...] }, one object p

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get one Carragent agent by its id (for example collections, scheduling, leads, reviews, report). Use it after list_agents or search_carragent when the user wants the details of one agent. Returns the agent: its summary, when it runs, its steps in order, what waits for the owner, what it never does a

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List Carragent's plans with monthly and yearly prices in USD cents (plus applicable taxes), their limits, the free-trial length and the refund terms. Use it when a user asks how much Carragent costs or which plan fits. Returns { plans: [...], terms: {...} }.

tools.name: search_carragent
tools.description: Keyword search over Carragent's agents and plans, best match first. Use it to find the agent for a task in the user's words, such as 'chase late invoices' or 'confirm appointments'. Returns { results: [...] }, each with its kind (agent or plan), id, name, description and score.
